meta_description:
20K likes, 160 comments - gauravmolri on September 9, 2026: "What you can eat for a Lean Body 😉

CHILLI SOYA CHUNKS || LENTIL SALAD || CRISPY BRINJAL || STAR FISH || CHILLI SAUCE 

GROCERY LIST 👇🏼
👉65G Soya Chunks 
👉200G Brown Lentils 
👉 250G Brinjal
👉 45G Rice 

Recipe for Chilli Soya Chunks 
👉Boil Soya for 15 Minutes in 500 ml water
👉1 Medium Tomatoes, Chillies 
👉 1 Small Onion

Once Cool enough squeeze sauce chunk and cook iy with veggies 

Lets Make Crispy Brinjal (Egg Plant) 

TO MARINATE: 
👉 Yogurt 2 Spoon 
👉 Besan 3 Spoon 
👉 Paprika 1 Spoon 

Mix well, and dip your brinjal into the marination 
Then cook it on pan until its brown both side

RECIPE FOR CHILLI SAUCE in comment 🫣

Oh just forgot the Lentil Salad, very simple 
I washed and boiled it untill its mushy and mix it with diced onion and lemon squeeze & you can add chaat masala if you want 

#highprotein #vegrecipes #lentil".
